title: Garments of Light and Darkness; the Crucified Light; the Two Essences
description: What the soul wears, what is laid down, what is built. T53 — the garments in which the soul goes forth, with love alone sufficing to quench the self's foolishness, and the four further accommodations that surround it as helpers; the order of the Lord's principles dwelling in concord forever. T54 — when divine humanity goes forth into the contest under the form the natural can meet, and the Lord's operative power rises out of the depths, the storehouses of the self go inactive: as a body without soul cannot operate, so what was claimed cannot work once the life within it has been gathered up. T55 — the building of the dwelling: how the operative power, taking up the firstfruits of the rational's five degrees, orders the firmaments so that the King of Honor may find a dwelling prepared when his coming is announced.
